as_told.title: Weygandt's drawing of the craft embedded in rock

plain: The story is that a young US Marine found a crashed alien craft in the Peruvian jungle and was then held and questioned for days. The Marine is Jonathan Weygandt, a lance corporal, who tells it himself on the show. He uses his own rough drawing of the jungle and the craft, which was "embedded" in the rock. A UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells it in more detail. He says Weygandt was in Peru for Operation Laser Strike, a counter-narcotics mission, and that his patrol came to a clearing where an enormous egg- or teardrop-shaped craft was stuck in a cliff face. A man named James Fox adds that Weygandt went up to it and saw a green liquid dripping out. In UAPGerb's account, men in Department of Energy rain jackets took Weygandt and flew him by CH-47 transport helicopter to an obscure military base. There he was interrogated for days, and Chinese and Germans were present alongside Americans. Michels repeats the story, crediting UAPGerb, and calls Weygandt part of a crash retrieval team. The tellers place it in 1997, while the story's own dating is the early 1990s. If true, it would mean crashed craft are recovered in secret, with several countries involved.
